notes.title: Monthly (not-so-weekly) Update!
notes.notes: [p]It has been a while since our last weekly update… so I guess this turned into a monthly one! But during this month we have been working hard to prepare for Gamescom and to address everything the community has been asking for. [/p][list][*][p]We fixed the most annoying bugs:, [/p][/*][*][p]No more situations where enemies are all defeated but the game does not move forward.,[/p][/*][*][p]The final cutscene after the boss no longer gets stuck., [/p][/*][*][p]Texts are now separated from the effects, so they are much more readable (your eyes will thank us).,[/p][/*][/list][p] On top of that, we added some of the features that Gamescom players already experienced: [/p][list][*][p]A brand new inventory system. Each inventory slot now has its own color and affects a specific die. This makes the game more strategic and requires more thought about the loot you pick.,[/p][/*][*][p]The boss has new mechanics… we will not spoil them, but let’s just say he has become nastier.,[/p][/*][/list][p] We are also making good progress on new content. The second level is almost complete and work has started on the following ones. We are implementing systems that make the game less dependent on luck and more enjoyable on every run. In parallel, we are working on localizing both the cutscenes and in-game texts. It is a massive task, but soon the game will be available in more languages. That’s all for this week. Next week we will share some tasty screenshots of bosses and enemies. In the meantime, the updated version is already available on Steam, so make sure to check it out![/p]

notes.title: Weekly Update!
notes.notes: [p]We’re making steady progress on the goals we had set, right now the upcoming update is in testing and revision, so we’re getting close![/p][p]In the meantime, we’re also working ahead and have started implementing 3 brand new classes that will be playable in the full game. Can’t wait to share more about them soon.[/p][p]Also... keep your ears open, a big announcement is coming 👀[/p]

notes.title: Weekly update!
notes.notes: [p][b]Big Change for the fortress, we’ve reworked the equipment system![/b] [/p][p]Now each of the 3 slots has a color (red, blue, or green), and you can only equip items that match the slot’s color. Each item affects the dice of the same color, so you’ll want to plan your loadout carefully. Purple items (like the shield) are wildcards and can go into any slot. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587016/210d4891e838c5644d11b3cb15f06ce007e17431.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Visual Improvement[/b] [/p][p]We’re also working on some visual improvements, like an updated settings menu and cutscenes that adapt properly to your screen resolution. On top of that, we’re trying to improve font readability — which is proving to be a real technical challenge due to how the project is set up, but we’re on it. All of this is [/p][p][b]coming in the update[/b] [b]scheduled for Monday, 07/14[/b]!  Remember! Your feedback give us the right path to follow, join our steam community and the [url="https://discord.gg/UD8nUyJeaR"]Discord Server[/url] to let us know your opinion![/p]

notes.title: The Fortress - Demo Update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful to all of you who played [i]The Fortress[/i] demo — your feedback has been amazing and incredibly valuable. Many of you took the time to share your thoughts, report bugs, and suggest improvements. We’ve read everything, and thanks to your input, the demo is now better than ever![/p][p]Here’s what we’ve fixed in this update:[/p][list][*][p]The health bar now increases when you gain extra health.[/p][/*][*][p]Items sold by the vampire now actually have a price![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where loot could get stuck on the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now pick up the relic without it disappearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Your ears are safe — you can finally adjust the volume in the settings![/p][/*][*][p]We’ve updated the font to improve readability and save your eyes a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]The crossbow item will no longer stay on screen permanently.[/p][/*][/list][p]And we’ve made some changes to the game mechanics too:[/p][list][*][p]You can now only take one item from loot drops — choose wisely![/p][/*][*][p]The special attack has been nerfed: it now takes 15 points to charge and deals 10 total damage split among enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now view your dodge and critical hit percentages in-game.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep playing the demo and letting us know what you think — your feedback is essential to help us turn [i]The Fortress[/i] into an even better game![/p][p]Thanks for being part of the journey![/p]
